text:
harper: big news drop  promoted to Staff SWE and accepted a wedding venue! feels wild. :tada: :ring:
milo: TWO huge congrats!! wedding AND promo?? when do we celebrate??
anya: omg congrats harper!! small poll: :sandwich: potluck lunch or :sparkles: after-work drinks? react to vote.
sasha: potluck for me. can volunteer savory + charcuterie (veg options).
tess: ill bring a dairy-free cake (harper allergy note: cashews). can someone grab candles?
harper: minor note  allergic to cashews, cannot do almond flour either. thanks for checking! i'm low-key panicking but also very grateful.
people-ops-bot: Promo logged: Harper promoted to Staff SWE. Swag tier unlocked. $200 celebratory budget allocated. Please DM People Ops to confirm gift vs donation.
kitchen-bot: Kitchen island availability: Fri 12:00-12:30 and Fri 16:30-17:00. Which slot works?
milo: midday is easiest. potluck lunch 12:00 then quick rooftop pic?
anya: vote check  react :sandwich: for lunch or :sparkles: for after-work.
sasha: :sandwich:
tess: :sandwich:
milo: :sandwich:
harper: :sandwich: thanks y'all.
people-ops-bot: Physical card request submitted. Link to sign: https://redwood.in/sigs/harper (link)
tess: i'll ask bakery to do a dairy-free vanilla sheet (nut-free). anyone want cupcakes too?
milo: i'll do a savory tray + drinks. i can stash a small plant as a wedding keepsake (succulent or fern?).
anya: i vote succulent. low fuss. i'll grab one and bring a tiny card.
sasha: i'll bring charcuterie (vegan cheese + crackers) and mini skewers.
harper: plant > anything battery-run. succulent sounds perfect. and please no confetti — cedar floors = hazard :sweat_smile:
tess: noted on no confetti. candles procured. who can pick up the bakery order at 11:15?
milo: i can swing by after my standup and grab it. send me receipt.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: $200 budget includes swag. Organizer, DM People Ops to finalize allocation before Thu EOD.
calendar-bot: Event created: "Harper promo + wedding mini-potluck" Fri 12:00-12:30 Kitchen Island + Rooftop photo. Zoom link attached for remote. Invites sent.
harper: youre all the best. tiny request: if anyone wants to drop a short congrats vid, please post here and i'll watch on the way to the venue meeting.
tess: remote folks can drop 10s clips and i'll compile.
anya: i'll make a quick playlist 3b6 for the table. low-key, please.
milo: receipt DMed to kai for bakery. picking up at 11:15.
harper: thank you again. this team really knows how to lift people up. see you Friday (or Zoom) :heart:
sasha (reaction): :tada: (added by sasha)
milo (reaction): :house_with_garden: (added by milo)
